ip.why: Local interface addresses distinguish off-box traffic from local connections.

ss.why: Linux per-socket byte counters and process ownership come from ss.

nettop.why: macOS per-process network byte counters come from nettop.

script.why: script gives the long-running macOS nettop logger the terminal it requires.

getent.why: Reverse lookups label remote addresses with host names.

lsof.why: Open-file and working-directory details come from lsof on macOS.

netstat.why: Interface totals provide the whole-machine traffic rate on macOS.

ps.why: Process command lines come from ps on macOS.
